messages:
samir: quick heads-up: spinning up 'orphan-admin radar' — target: find role grants that landed ownerlike perms via modules/automation and unattended group membership. short window: last 45 days. will produce remediation draft.
claire: keen. share the detection query pls.
samir: here — run in auditdb (uses grant_changes). will include KMS hints.
claire: ```sql
-- detect ownerlike grants with no declared owner_tag
SELECT grantee, role, resource, ARRAY_AGG(attachment ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] as evidence, COUNT(*) AS changes
FROM auditdb.grant_changes
WHERE ts > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 45 DAY)
  AND (role ILIKE '%owner%' OR role ILIKE '%admin%')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metadata.owners WHERE subject = grantee)
GROUP BY grantee, role, resource
ORDER BY changes DESC
LIMIT 300;
```
